# pvecli ceph flags

Ceph OSD flags and which ones are currently set.

```text
pvecli ceph flags [OPTIONS]
```

## Options

| Option | Description |
|:--|:--|
| `-p`, `--profile VALUE` | Profile to use. |
| `-js`, `--json` | Output raw JSON to stdout (no colors, no tables). |
